text.p: TORONTO, Aug 11 Reuter) - The following are top headlines from selected Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-Ottawa skips reactor advice: Warnings about environmental impact ignored in Candu sale to China, documents show
-Stiffer drug penalties urged: Attorney-General of B.C. seeks change
-Arafat, Israeli officials meet: U.S. envoy brings sides together
-Police predict showdown over inclusion in Bill 136: Proposed Ontario law rules out independendent arbitration
-Camp alumni relive old days: Adults are returning to their childhood vacation spots, for work and play, to reclaim their memories and have some simple fun.
-Crunch time looms for Eaton's: As court date nears, the big question is how much new equity is in retailer's survival plan
-U.S. bold, Canada cautious on deficit strategy: Washington races ahead with tax cuts; Ottawa makes no promises for surplus
-CanWest, WICC to vie for Quebec's anglo TV viewers: Major showdown expected over news broadcasts
-Fired-up steels won't be tempered, analysts say
Bond selloff triggers rush out of equities: Employment figures add to market gloom
-Mitel snaps up Gandalf assets in fire sale
